title: v1_125 / Thank you
content: ## Thank you Contributions to `vscode`: * [@arun-357 (Arunachalam Nachiappan)](https://github.com/arun-357) * Fix raw markdown shown in image carousel caption [PR #320754](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/320754) * Fix image carousel showing UUID on hover in modal editor title [PR #320739](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/320739) * Use a media icon for the Images Preview editor label [PR #320951](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/320951) * [@dymaaaj7 (Dimitrije)](https://github.com/dymaaaj7): Fix declaration order of File and Reference in CompletionItemKind [PR #314958](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/314958) * [@g0w6y (ⳕⲛτⲉⲅⲥⲉⳏτⲟⲅ 🕵🏻)](https://github.com/g0w6y): Validate redirect scheme and strip credentials on cross-origin redirects in MCP HTTP client [PR #320347](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/320347) * [@guomaggie](https://github.com/guomaggie): Switch from Copilot Proxy to CAPI V3 [PR #320472](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/320472) * [@kangarko (Matej)](https://github.com/kangarko): Add setting to open changed chat files in an editor instead of a diff [PR #320948](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/320948) * [@lucaspar (Lucas Parzianello)](https://github.com/lucaspar): Fixed typo in cli update [PR #245751](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/245751) * [@merfanian (Mahdi Erfanian)](https://github.com/merfanian): Preserve image source provenance across chat reference API boundary [PR #320624](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/320624) * [@RedCMD (RedCMD)](https://github.com/RedCMD): fix: Restrict continue comment to whitespace separated slashes [PR #321230](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/321230) * [@Tyriar (Daniel Imms)](https://github.com/Tyriar): fix(terminal): track ligatures addon config for change detection [PR #318992](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/318992) ### Issue tracking Contributions to our issue tracking: * [@gjsjohnmurray (John Murray)](https://github.com/gjsjohnmurray) * [@RedCMD
